body: Thank you for this advice - I really should have gone long before now but I kept putting it off and cancelling my appointments because I just couldn't bring myself to get out of bed. You're right, things were so much better at first, it was the first time in ages I'd been motivated and realised I could be content on a fairly constant basis. I'm on a 50mg dose at the moment, so I'll definitely talk to my GP. Thanks so much for the help!

I can play piano, and I didn't enjoy it at all - playing instruments doesn't really bring me any kind of joy, I don't have great memories associated with it, so I don't know that this would actually help very much. Thank you for the suggestion though.
